========================================
  BIKE GEARING CALCULATOR
  Windows Standalone Application
========================================

HOW TO RUN:
-----------
1. Double-click "BikeGearingCalculator.exe"
2. A command window will open showing "Server running at http://localhost:3000"
3. Open your web browser
4. Navigate to: http://localhost:3000
5. Start using the calculator!

TO STOP:
--------
- Press Ctrl+C in the command window
- Or simply close the command window

IMPORTANT NOTES:
----------------
- Keep the command window open while using the app
- No installation required
- No internet connection needed
- Works completely offline

SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS:
--------------------
- Windows 7 or later
- Any modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari)
- Port 3000 must be available

TROUBLESHOOTING:
----------------
Q: "Windows protected your PC" warning appears?
A: Click "More info" then "Run anyway" - this is normal for unsigned apps

Q: "Port 3000 already in use" error?
A: Close other applications using port 3000, or modify the port in server.js

Q: Browser doesn't load the page?
A: Make sure you're going to http://localhost:3000 (not https)

DISTRIBUTION:
-------------
You can copy this entire folder to share the application with others.
No additional files or installation needed!
